name: Passing Glance
body:
School illusion (phantasm)); Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a mothball)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will (see text); Spell Resistance yes

When you cast this spell you seem slightly hazy and nondescript to enemies. Whenever you would be the target of an attack the originating creature must attempt a Will Save, failure means they overlook you as an option and must choose another target in range. If there is no other valid target in the attacker’s range, this spell has no effect on the attacker.
